stb_truetype v1.28, by Sean Barrett / RAD Game Tools
Upstream: https://github.com/nothings/stb
File: stb_truetype.h, at commit
  9f755b604db3492df2cbeb39bf84b81e3e3932e3
MIT or public domain, at your choice (LICENSE, the file's own closing block).

Changes:

1. stbtt__hheap_alloc: the active-edge allocator takes 16 edges a chunk, not
   2000 (or 800, or 100, by edge size). A chunk of 2000 is about 29 KB of
   scratch for a glyph that has a handful of edges active at once; with 16, a
   Material Symbols icon peaks at about 6.5 KB and the pixels are identical
   (checked over 129 icons at 16, 18, 20 and 24 px). ttfio runs stb from one
   fixed buffer, so the chunk size sets how big that buffer must be.
